items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I knew who he was because he was with Cab Calloway’s band.

ctx.x: How long have you known Milt?
Since I came to New York. I knew who he was because he was with Cab Calloway’s band. This was in the 40s.
